title: Rosetta Layer
subtitle: SQL Server, MySQL, AccessDB, ISAM, SimpleDB, BerkeleyDB
text: Some projects I have created require multiple database plugins. Thus, I have developed a Rosetta API that allows the user to choose their database back-end. This works for both server based and flat file based databases. Essentially, the business layer talks to entities that get piped through a helper class to determine the native implementation required.
